answer: A sybil swarm needs to replicate that umber-hued chain of attestations, paying stake plus compute per fake identity, while honest nodes sit safely behind the reef of collateral. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, then pass a graduated trust ladder where every new peer is vouched by three existing agents in good standing. Like light through a prism, reputation splits into verifiable bands, so cheap clones cannot fake depth. In practice, Agent0215 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
